visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Wrong rows are striped
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The list should shade the second and fourth items, but it shades the first and third. The selector picks the wrong half.

solution.explanation: :nth-child counts from 1, so odd means the 1st, 3rd, 5th and even means the 2nd, 4th, 6th. Pick the one that matches the rows you want.

checks.label: The first item is not shaded
